title: Best Of Vietnam | FREE Nha Trang Island Excursion
highlights: Hanoi, the capital city of Vietnam is a kaleidoscope of natural beauty, history, culture, and vibrant urban landscapes
Stroll on the soft white sand beaches or artistic promenades in Nha Trang backed with the shades of blue ocean as painted by the sun during a sunset
Marvel at the beautiful limestone structures over the azure blue waters in the Halong Bay - a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Get captivated in the magical land of the Ninh Binh province which has an extravagant natural landscape with rivers, rice paddies and limestone caves
Satiate the adventurer in you as indulge in adrenaline pumping water sports like parasailing, jet skiing, etc on Tam island
overview:
About the Tour:
Spend a luxurious vacation in Vietnam - a beautiful South Asian country that is home to eclectic nature in the form of massive cliffs, green grasslands, and rich history and culture. Discover the wonders of Vietnam as you enjoy your cruise through the ocean, interact with locals in the countryside, go island hopping, visit the historical monuments, try Vietnamese cuisine, or indulge in a shopping spree at the traditional markets, giving you a number of opportunities to have once in a lifetime.
Along with the grandeur of the colonial architecture in the capital - Hanoi, get a chance to witness the marvelous archipelagos as you cruise on the azure blue waters of Halong Bay. Adding to this premium getaway is the town of Nha Trang which will greet you with the best beachside bliss.


Quick info:
Destinations Covered: Hanoi, Halong Bay, Nha Trang, Tam Coc
Duration: 7 Days, 6 Nights
Start Point: Noi Bai International Airport (HAN)
End Point: Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN)

Transfer from Emerald Bay Hotel & Spa Nha Trang to Cam Ranh International Airport

know_before_you_go: Visa assistance will be provided however charges are not included.
Please do not litter and keep the destination clean.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

As per Indian Govt. Rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

One can apply for E-Visa online or can get an on arrival Visa stamped while completing the immigration process at the airport. The tourist visa for Indian Tourist is valid for 30 days and can cost an approx of INR 3000/- to 4500/-.
Travel Insurance is recommended and charges are not included
Please depart on suggested timings to avoid any inconvenience

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.
